intro.line: An Omenpath opens in a round green door. Behind it a kettle is boiling, and a great many Dwarves are arriving for tea.
There is a long road ahead, an old map, a stolen ring and a mountain with something asleep inside it.
Recorded: crossings sit outside Magic canon. You are only passing through.

finale.line: The Dragon falls out of the sky over the Long Lake, and the Mountain is open again.
I am Bard, slayer of the Dragon!
The Omenpath folds shut behind a Hobbit who is already thinking about his own front door.

villainFinale.line: In this version the Dragon never meets the black arrow. The Lonely Mountain stays his, and Esgaroth burns.
You think you will get a fair share? If you get off alive, you will be lucky.
The Omenpath holds long enough for you to leave.

battles.title: An Unexpected Party
battles.blurb: Thirteen Dwarves, one wizard and a night on the road that goes badly wrong.

cards.name: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills
An Unexpected Party // At the Door

scene.line: I am an honest burglar, more or less.
Treasure tokens turn into any colour of mana once. Save one for the turn you need it.

villainScene.line: Suddenly they were fighting like dogs, and calling one another all sorts of perfectly true and applicable names in very loud voices.
The Trolls are in no hurry. Dinner will keep.

hero.half: Cash a Treasure when you need the colour.

battles.title: Goblin-town
battles.blurb: A grey wizard, a flash of light and a cave full of goblins.

scene.line: Gandalf thought of most things; and though he could not do everything, he could do a great deal for friends in a tight corner.
Amass: grow your Army token or make one first. Kill the Army and all of its counters go with it.

villainScene.line: I will prepare something particularly uncomfortable for you, Thorin Oakenshield!
Clap! Snap! The Goblins have a song for it.

hero.half: Spread counters on one Army, or split into two.

battles.title: Riddles in the Dark
battles.blurb: A hobbit, a ring in a pocket and a creature who loves riddles and raw fish.

scene.line: What have I got in my pocket?
Recruit: draw a card, then discard one. If it was a nonland card, you get a Treasure. Loot every turn.

villainScene.line: Where iss it? Losst it is, my precious!

hero.half: Recruit each turn: loot, then keep the Treasure.

battles.title: Beorn
battles.blurb: The skin-changer does not like visitors. He especially does not like fifteen of them.

cards.name: Beorn, Reluctant Host // Till and Tend

scene.line: Perhaps you have heard of my good cousin Radagast who lives near the southern borders of Mirkwood?
Beorn is a big green deck. Trade early, then stop him with removal before he lands the bears.

villainScene.line: He never invited people into his house if he could help it. Now he had got fifteen strangers sitting in his porch!
The bears dance until dawn. The strangers are not invited.

hero.half: Remove the big green creature before it connects.

battles.title: Mirkwood
battles.blurb: Stick to the forest-track. The spiders have been waiting.

scene.line: A Saga adds a counter every turn and does its work in order. Cast it early and let the chapters run.

villainScene.line: Soon there came the sound of "Lazy Lob" and "Attercop" from among the trees away on the right. That upset the spiders greatly.
Attercop, Attercop! The meat is alive and kicking.

hero.half: Cast the Saga early, then protect your creatures.

battles.title: The Dwarves of Erebor
battles.blurb: The Mountain-king has an army, an axe and a very long list of grudges.

deck.name: The Brown Wizard and the Bears
deck.label: tribute

cards.name: Beorn, Reluctant Host // Till and Tend

scene.line: Merry be the greenwood, while the world is yet young! And merry be all your folk!
Dwarves hit hard and early. Bigger creatures with trample win the long game.

villainScene.line: Dáin heard Thorin's urgent plea and ordered his smiths to fetch their strongest axes and mattocks.
The Iron Hills march: every Dwarf has a score and an axe.

hero.half: Land your big creatures before the Dwarves swarm.

battles.title: The Elvenking
battles.blurb: The Wood-Elves are not wicked folk. They do not like to be asked questions in their halls.

deck.name: The Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain
deck.label: tribute

scene.line: We shall soon, before the break of day, start on our long journey
The Elvenking counters your best spell. Bait it with a lesser one first.

villainScene.line: I have a right to know what brings you here, and if you will not tell me now, I will keep you all in prison until you have learned sense and manners!
The halls are old, quiet and very patient.

hero.half: Bait the counterspell with a lesser spell.

battles.title: Smaug the Magnificent
battles.blurb: The last of the great Dragons sleeps on a bed of gold and listens for burglars.

cards.name: Smaug, the Great Calamity // Spew Flame

scene.line: No one had dared to face the Dragon for many an age; nor would they have dared now, if it hadn't been for the grim-voiced Bard urging them on.
Smaug is a flyer and burns the board. Keep your best arrow in hand for the right moment.

villainScene.line: My armor is like tenfold shields, my teeth are swords, my wings a hurricane, and my breath death!
You think you will get a fair share? If you get off alive, you will be lucky.

hero.half: Keep your answer for the Dragon himself.

battles.title: The Battle of Five Armies
battles.blurb: The Dragon is dead, but the Goblins have been waiting. Bolg of the North is coming.

archive.what: A black-red deck of the set's goblin captains and Armies, with Gathering of Darkness at the top.
archive.why: It stands for the battle after the Dragon and is not a list anyone won with.
archive.beat: Trade early, keep the Army small, and kill Bolg before the horde grows.
archive.after: Nothing; this is the optional superboss at the end of the story.

cards.name: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills

deck.name: The Goblin Host of Bolg
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's set only. No tournament list is copied.

scene.line: Alas! Bolg of the North is coming!
Race the Army before it grows. Kill Bolg and the horde breaks.

villainScene.line: Goblins and wolves returned to the assault and soon forced their foes into a great ring, hemmed on all sides.

after.line: Recorded: the Eagles arrive, and the Mountain holds. The Omenpath closes.

hero.half: Kill the Army token before it grows.
